list.name: Changes
list.comment: - Finished implementing Hallowed one and made Void and Hallowed mobs attack each other. - Added some new Hallowed items. - Removed vanilla mobs & structures from biome spawn lists. - Made Elves and Corrupted Elves attack each other. - Added the first five AltDim OST tracks: Fallen Hero, Lost Ruins, Outcast, Fading Away, and Final Struggle. - Converted more vanilla blocks/items to custom versions. - Added & fixed custom crafting tables for different woods. - Added Romans, Vikings, their drops, and their reputation mechanic. - Added wooden tools for all wood types. - Added Phosphorium and Phosphorium Tools. - Rebalanced ore generation. - Added custom furnaces for each strata type. - Fixed many bugs
